theorem_obligations.intent: If complete guard evaluates to false, execution returns guardFalse with unchanged state.
theorem_obligations.precise_statement_in_words: For all s i, if evalGuard s i.guard = some false then execCnotB32 s i = some (ExecOutcome.guardFalse s).
theorem_obligations.lean_statement_sketch: theorem cnotB32_exec_guard_false_no_state_change (s : MachineState) (i : CnotB32Instruction) (h : evalGuard s i.guard = some false) : execCnotB32 s i = some (ExecOutcome.guardFalse s)
hypotheses: h : evalGuard s i.guard = some false
theorem_obligations.non_vacuity_argument: There are concrete states/instructions with guard false (e.g., explicit @p negation false). The theorem states behavior rather than restating syntax.
strength_risks: Avoid weakening h to unguarded cases.
theorem_obligations.proof_strategy_hint: Split on evalGuard and simplify execCnotB32 on the `some false` branch.

theorem_obligations.intent: On true guard and resolvable source, the destination register gets `cnotB32` of source value.
theorem_obligations.precise_statement_in_words: Under guard=true, destination reg r and source value va, execCnotB32 produces executed state where r equals cnotB32 va.
theorem_obligations.lean_statement_sketch: theorem cnotB32_exec_true_guard_writes_cnot_result (s : MachineState) (i : CnotB32Instruction) (r : RegId) (va : U32) (hguard : evalGuard s i.guard = some true) (hd : i.d = Destination.reg r) (ha : evalSource s i.a = some va) : ∃ s', execCnotB32 s i = some (ExecOutcome.executed s') ∧ s'.valueRegs r = some (cnotB32 va)
hypotheses: hguard : evalGuard s i.guard = some true
ha : evalSource s i.a = some va
theorem_obligations.conclusion: ∃ s', execCnotB32 s i = some (ExecOutcome.executed s') ∧ s'.valueRegs r = some (cnotB32 va)
theorem_obligations.non_vacuity_argument: Choosing any non-ambiguous source value (e.g., 0 and 1) yields distinct written values 1 and 0.
strength_risks: Destination non-register is intentionally out-of-scope in this obligation set.
theorem_obligations.proof_strategy_hint: Simplify the true/source-present branch, then substitute destination.

theorem_obligations.precise_statement_in_words: execCnotB32 s i is none iff guard is missing, or guard is true and source is missing.
theorem_obligations.lean_statement_sketch: theorem cnotB32_exec_none_iff_missing_guard_or_true_source (s : MachineState) (i : CnotB32Instruction) : execCnotB32 s i = none ↔ (evalGuard s i.guard = none) ∨ (evalGuard s i.guard = some true ∧ evalSource s i.a = none)
theorem_obligations.conclusion: execCnotB32 s i = none ↔ (evalGuard s i.guard = none) ∨ (evalGuard s i.guard = some true ∧ evalSource s i.a = none)
theorem_obligations.non_vacuity_argument: Both antecedents are realizable in concrete partial machine states: missing guard and true-missing-source.
strength_risks: Do not accidentally include guard=false in the none branch.
theorem_obligations.proof_strategy_hint: Case split on evalGuard then evalSource under some true.
